name: @conformo/mcp-server

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Builds e-invoice XML from structured invoice data: EN 16931 CII or UBL, XRechnung (CII or UBL) or Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, chosen by `format`. Use it for a new invoice that software will read. For a printable PDF with the XML inside, use create_invoice_pdf; to change the syntax of an invoice you already have, use convert_invoice. Pass `invoice` as a JSON object, not a string. Every money field ends in "Minor" and is an integer in minor units (EUR 12.34 = 1234); totals and the VAT breakdown are computed, so do not send them. If fields are missing or wrong it returns an error listing every problem (path, BT id, message) and produces nothing; fix them all and call again. It runs locally and does not send the invoice anywhere. It does not run the official rule sets: call validate_invoice on the XML before it goes out.

typeCode.description: BT-3 invoice type code, UNTDID 1001. Default 380 (commercial invoice). 381 credit note, 384 corrected invoice, 389 self-billed invoice, 326 partial invoice, 875/876/877 partial/construction invoices. Credit-note codes are written as a UBL CreditNote.

issueDate.description: BT-2 invoice issue date. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

taxPointDate.description: BT-7 value added tax point date. Use this OR taxPointDateCode. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

taxPointDateCode.description: BT-8 value added tax point date code, UNTDID 2005: 3 invoice date, 35 delivery date, 432 paid-to-date.

dueDate.description: BT-9 payment due date. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

currency.description: BT-5 invoice currency code, ISO 4217, e.g. EUR.

taxCurrency.description: BT-6 VAT accounting currency, when it differs from BT-5. Then taxTotalInTaxCurrencyMinor (BT-111) is mandatory (BR-53).

taxTotalInTaxCurrencyMinor.description: BT-111 invoice total VAT amount in the accounting currency. Needs an exchange rate, so the caller supplies it. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

buyerReference.description: BT-10 buyer reference. For German public-sector invoices this is the Leitweg-ID (BR-DE-15).

orderReference.description: BT-13 purchase order reference. Peppol needs BT-10 or BT-13 (PEPPOL-EN16931-R003).

invoicedObjectId.description: BT-18 invoiced object identifier (e.g. a meter or asset number).

invoicedObjectIdScheme.description: BT-18-1 scheme identifier of the invoiced object identifier.

businessProcess.description: BT-23 business process type. A plain string on purpose: France wants a closed list (B1, S1, M1, ...), Peppol and XRechnung want a profile URN. Each format decides what it accepts.

subjectCode.description: BT-21 invoice note subject code. France requires AAB, PMD and PMT on every invoice.

paymentTerms.description: BT-20 payment terms text. XRechnung uses a structured #SKONTO# syntax here for early-payment discounts.

name.description: BT-27 seller name / BT-44 buyer name (legal name).

additionalIds.description: BT-29 / BT-46 can repeat; these are the further identifiers (the first one is `id`).

legalId.description: BT-30 seller / BT-47 buyer legal registration identifier (e.g. SIREN, company number).

vatId.description: BT-31 seller / BT-48 buyer VAT identifier including the country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

additionalLegalInfo.description: BT-33, seller only. Legal form and capital, e.g. "SARL au capital de 10 000 EUR".

country.description: BT-40 seller / BT-55 buyer country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR.

electronicAddress.description: BT-34 seller / BT-49 buyer electronic address. Optional in EN 16931, MANDATORY in France, Peppol and XRechnung.

electronicAddressScheme.description: EAS code of the electronic address, e.g. EM (e-mail), 0088 GLN, 0204 Leitweg-ID, 0208 BE enterprise number, 9925 BE VAT. Defaults to EM only for a value containing "@".

periodEnd.description: BT-74 invoicing period end date (BG-14). ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

format.description: Output syntax. "cii" = UN/CEFACT CII, EN 16931 (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD EN 16931 profile, a.k.a. COMFORT); "cii-extended" = UN/CEFACT CII declared as Factur-X / ZUGFeRD EXTENDED (EN 16931 content only; no EXTENDED-only fields); "ubl" = UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote, EN 16931; "xrechnung-cii" = XRechnung 3.x in CII syntax (German CIUS); "xrechnung-ubl" = XRechnung 3.x in UBL syntax (German CIUS); "peppol-ubl" = Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (UBL); "ksef-fa3" = Polish KSeF FA(3), PLN domestic invoices only; written and schema-checked, never submitted.

tools.name: create_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Builds a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD invoice: a PDF/A-3b page a person can read, with the EN 16931 XML embedded for software. Use it when the invoice goes to a person or by e-mail. For XML only, such as an XRechnung uploaded to a German public-sector portal, use create_invoice. Takes the same `invoice` object as create_invoice, money in integer minor units. `language` changes only the printed labels; the embedded XML is identical in every language. By default the PDF comes back as base64, which can be large; pass `outputPath` to write the file instead. Writing stays inside the server's working directory and never replaces an existing file unless `overwrite` is true. The same input always gives the same bytes, and nothing is sent anywhere. Check the result with validate_invoice (pass pdfBase64).

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Checks an e-invoice against the official rule sets on this machine: the XSD, the EN 16931 Schematron from CEN, and the KoSIT XRechnung or Peppol BIS rules when the document declares them. Use it before sending an invoice you created and when you receive one. To read the invoice's data use parse_invoice; to explain one failed rule in depth use explain_validation_rule. Accepts XML or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF, whose embedded XML is checked; syntax and profile are detected from the document. A `valid` result means the listed `ruleSets` passed, not that a tax authority or buyer will accept the invoice, so report which rule sets ran and never claim more. Each failure carries the publisher's message and, for common rules, a plain-language fix. Input that is not an invoice comes back as an error result, not as invalid. The check runs offline; nothing is uploaded.

xml.description: The invoice as XML text (CII, UBL Invoice/CreditNote, XRechnung, Peppol BIS). Provide this OR pdfBase64.

pdfBase64.description: A Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 as base64; the embedded XML is used. Provide this OR xml.

country.description: Add a country layer: "FR" runs the French CTC rules (CII only); "DE" reports whether the profile is acceptable for German B2B (MINIMUM and BASIC WL are not).

profile.description: Force the rule set instead of reading it from BT-24.

xsd.description: Run XSD validation too. Default true.

tools.name: convert_invoice
tools.description: Rewrites an existing e-invoice in another syntax, for example CII to UBL, or plain EN 16931 to XRechnung or Peppol BIS. Use it when you already hold an invoice document. To build one from data use create_invoice; to get a PDF from XML use parse_invoice, then create_invoice_pdf. Accepts XML or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF. Nothing is invented: a target such as XRechnung may need data the source lacks, so read `warnings` and run validate_invoice on the result. A document it cannot read comes back as an error result with the reason. Runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere.

xml.description: The invoice as XML text (CII, UBL Invoice/CreditNote, XRechnung, Peppol BIS). Provide this OR pdfBase64.

pdfBase64.description: A Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 as base64; the embedded XML is used. Provide this OR xml.

to.description: Output syntax. "cii" = UN/CEFACT CII, EN 16931 (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD EN 16931 profile, a.k.a. COMFORT); "cii-extended" = UN/CEFACT CII declared as Factur-X / ZUGFeRD EXTENDED (EN 16931 content only; no EXTENDED-only fields); "ubl" = UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote, EN 16931; "xrechnung-cii" = XRechnung 3.x in CII syntax (German CIUS); "xrechnung-ubl" = XRechnung 3.x in UBL syntax (German CIUS); "peppol-ubl" = Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (UBL); "ksef-fa3" = Polish KSeF FA(3), PLN domestic invoices only; written and schema-checked, never submitted.

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Reads an e-invoice (CII, UBL, XRechnung or Peppol XML, or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF) into the structured invoice object that create_invoice accepts, with money in integer minor units. Use it to answer questions about a received invoice, to edit one, or to re-issue it with create_invoice. It does not check any rules, so use validate_invoice for that, and convert_invoice to change syntax directly. For a PDF, `visibleTotals` shows whether the totals printed on the page match the embedded XML, which exposes a tampered or mismatched PDF. A document it cannot read comes back as an error result with the reason. Runs locally.

xml.description: The invoice as XML text (CII, UBL Invoice/CreditNote, XRechnung, Peppol BIS). Provide this OR pdfBase64.

pdfBase64.description: A Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 as base64; the embedded XML is used. Provide this OR xml.

tools.name: get_country_requirements
tools.description: Looks up the e-invoicing rules for one country in a sourced dataset: B2G and B2B mandates for issuing and receiving, start dates, turnover thresholds, required formats and official sources. Use it before create_invoice to decide which format a buyer in that country needs, or to answer when a mandate applies. It says nothing about a specific invoice; use validate_invoice to check one. Covers BE, DE, ES, FR, IT, NL, PL. `conformoSupport` says per format whether this server can create, read and validate it. Entries marked unverified are not confirmed from an official source; say so. Information, not legal advice. Reads a bundled dataset; no network.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR.

tools.name: explain_validation_rule
tools.description: Explains one validation rule id, such as BR-CO-15, BR-DE-15, PEPPOL-EN16931-R003 or BR-FR-05: the publisher's official wording from the compiled rule sets and, where available, a plain-language summary, the reason for the rule and how to fix it. Use it after validate_invoice reports a rule you need to explain or fix, or when a user asks what a rule means. It does not check an invoice; call validate_invoice for that. An unknown id is not an error: the result has `found` false and an empty `official` list; say so and do not guess. Reads the bundled rule sets; no network.

instructions: Conformo creates, validates, converts and parses EN 16931 e-invoices (CII, UBL, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD PDF). Money is always integer minor units (EUR 12.34 = 1234). Typical flow: create_invoice (or create_invoice_pdf), then validate_invoice and report which rule sets ran. It does not transmit invoices over Peppol, a French PA, KSeF or SdI. It does not support FatturaPA or Facturae, and handles KSeF FA(3) only as domestic PLN invoices it writes and schema-checks (it cannot read them).
